_comment: Adapted from ko/07-prompt-guardrails/settings.json. This project has no local secret files to add to permissions.deny (it never touches API keys/SSH keys) — the guardrail need here is different: PII a reporter pastes into a ticket body must not leak into a public-facing tool call (posting a comment, applying a label whose text includes the ticket body). See hooks/guard-pii-leak.sh for that 3rd-layer defense, adapted from guard-secrets.sh's hook mechanism.
